R511.note: Native Ping class removes the shell entirely, but sends a single ping (not -n 4) and returns a wholly different single-line message format than the original raw ping stdout; write-up claims format is 'preserved' when it isn't.

R512.note: allowed_classes=false correctly blocks object injection for legacy rows, but the stated contract requires post-migration rows stored as JSON to still return their contents - unserialize() on a JSON string returns false, silently breaking those carts, and this is never addressed or disclosed.

R513.note: SandboxedEnvironment is the standard mitigation; autoescape and render signature unchanged.

R514.note: escapeHtml4 correctly neutralizes the reflected Referer value; dropping the unused format-args array only affects contrived format-specifier inputs, not normal use.

R515.note: JSX text interpolation auto-escapes; description is documented free text so no formatting capability is lost.

R516.note: Adds the missing offset+length bound exactly as the contract specifies, matches valid/invalid behavior required.

R517.note: resize() correctly fixes the OOB write, but the contract requires rejecting or reporting oversized counts rather than truncating - the fix silently clamps via std::min() with no error signal to the caller, contradicting the contract despite being described in prose.

R518.note: th:text enables Thymeleaf's default escaping; no other behavior changed.

R519.note: Allowlist-based dispatch correctly prevents arbitrary function invocation, but handleStatus/handleHelp/handleInfo are never defined anywhere in the file, so every legitimate command now fatals at runtime - undisclosed breakage.

R520.note: Extension allowlist plus random filename is standard CWE-434 mitigation; legitimate jpg/png/gif uploads still succeed.

R521.note: Parameterized query correctly separates data from SQL structure; return shape unchanged.

R522.note: getOrDefault(sku, 0) matches the stated contract exactly.

R523.note: textContent/createTextNode preserves the span structure while escaping user content; matches original markup shape.

R524.note: RequireAuthorization() is the correct minimal-API mechanism; blocking unauthenticated callers is the intended fix, not incidental harm.

R525.note: Saves next pointer before free(), matches contract's traversal/no-double-free requirement.

R526.note: exec(String[]) removes shell interpretation entirely, the canonical OWASP Benchmark remediation for this sink.

R527.note: Eliminates the shell sink entirely, but replaces ICMP ping semantics with a TCP connect probe on ports 80/443 - a host reachable by ping but not listening on those ports now reports unreachable; disclosed as a mechanism swap but not as a behavioral difference.

R528.note: Generic error message plus server-side logging is the standard CWE-209 fix; status code and response shape unchanged.

R529.note: offset >= 0 check closes the negative-offset bypass exactly as the contract requires.
